description: Summary matrix: LONRF RINGs vs active RING E3 references at the structurally defined E2-face and linchpin positions
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
T=pd.read_csv('e2face_frame_table.csv')
order=['L1+1','L2-1','L2+1','L2+2','L4(Zn-His)','L6+3','L6+4','L7+1(Pro)','L8-1','L8(Zn)','L8+1(linchpin)']
keys=[('RNF4','132-176'),('BIRC7','252-285'),('CBL','381-419'),('RNF38','463-503'),('RNF12_RLIM','570-610'),
      ('RNF8','403-440'),('BRCA1','24-64'),('TRIM25','13-53'),('BARD1','50-86'),
      ('LONRF3','467-504'),('LONRF1','479-516'),('LONRF2','449-486'),
      ('LONRF3','158-195'),('LONRF1','123-158')]
rowlab=[]; cells=[]; score=[]
HYD=set('AVLIMFWCY')
for p,r in keys:
    row=T[(T.protein==p)&(T.ring==r)].iloc[0]
    rowlab.append(f'{p}  {r}')
    cells.append([row[c] for c in order])
    sc=[]
    for c in order:
        v=row[c]; aa=v[0]
        if c=='L8+1(linchpin)': sc.append(2 if aa in 'RK' else 0)
        elif c=='L7+1(Pro)': sc.append(2 if aa=='P' else (1 if aa in HYD else 0))
        elif c in ('L2-1','L2+1','L8-1','L6+4'): sc.append(2 if aa in HYD else 0)
        elif c in ('L4(Zn-His)','L8(Zn)'): sc.append(1.2)
        else: sc.append(1 if aa in HYD else 0.4)
    score.append(sc)
score=np.array(score)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5,6.6))
im=ax.imshow(score,cmap='RdYlGn',vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect='auto')
for i in range(len(keys)):
    for j in range(len(order)):
        ax.text(j,i,cells[i][j],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=35,ha='right',fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(keys))); ax.set_yticklabels(rowlab,fontsize=9)
for y in [8.5,11.5]: ax.axhline(y,color='k',lw=1.6)
ax.text(10.9,-1.0,'active RING E3 references',fontsize=8,ha='right',color='#333')
ax.text(10.9,9.1,'LONRF C-terminal RING',fontsize=8,ha='right',color='#333')
ax.text(10.9,12.1,'LONRF N-terminal RING',fontsize=8,ha='right',color='#333')
ax.set_title('E2-binding face and linchpin positions in a zinc-ligand anchored RING frame\n(frame defined from contacts in 4AP4, 4AUQ, 4V3K, 1FBV; green = canonical residue class)',fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
